summary: A notice from MIT that its PDP-10 at Project MAC, the Dynamic Modeling System, would be down for at least ten days from about December 26, 1972, to install a paging system. It may be less available for a few weeks after.

plainLanguage.summary: MIT Project MAC announced that its Dynamic Modeling System would stop operating around December 26 while a paging system was installed. The notice warns that availability might remain reduced for a few weeks after service resumed.

subtitle: A notice about a holiday shutdown at MIT Project MAC

tldr.problem: MIT's Dynamic Modeling System was scheduled to stop operating while a paging system was installed.
tldr.mechanism: The notice estimates a shutdown beginning around December 26, 1972, lasting at least 10 days and possibly as long as three weeks.
tldr.outcome: Network liaisons were warned that the system might also be less available during the first weeks after the installation.

today: RFC 419 is an operational notice about a planned MIT Project MAC system shutdown. It describes the expected outage and the possible availability limits after the paging installation.

sections.title: Planned System Shutdown
sections.content: The PDP-10 at Project MAC, called the Dynamic Modeling System, was expected to stop operating on or about December 26, 1972. The notice estimates that it would be unavailable for at least 10 days and possibly as long as three weeks, including for network use.
sections.plainLanguage: The Dynamic Modeling System was expected to go offline around December 26. The notice gives a minimum and possible maximum length for the shutdown.

sections.title: Installing a Paging System
sections.content: The shutdown would allow the team to install a paging system. The notice does not describe the equipment or give technical details about the installation.
sections.plainLanguage: The system would be offline so staff could install a paging system. The notice does not explain how that system would work.

sections.title: Availability After the Shutdown
sections.content: The notice warns that during the first few weeks of paging-system operation, the Dynamic Modeling System might not be as available as it had been before. It informs network liaisons and station agents of both the shutdown and the possible reduced availability afterward.
sections.plainLanguage: Even after the system returned, users were warned that it might be less available for a few weeks.
